item.title: The Hindu: Kerala High Court’s remarks trigger fresh debate on Kochi’s night life
item.description: Court’s question on whether the police are opposed to nightlife altogether sparks debate over the city’s growing appetite for late-night events and gatherings and long-standing concerns raised by law enforcers

item.title: The Hindu: Mallussery mango, Pokkali rice among people’s favourites as official species for Ernakulam
item.description: Suggestions sought from public as part of a joint initiative by the district panchayat and the Biodiversity Management Committee

item.title: The Hindu: India, Bulgaria discuss bilateral ties, IMEC, Black Sea situation
item.description: ‘Our teams have drawn up a detailed roadmap of cooperation, so we will be approving that today, and I think that will give a very clear pathway to our activities ahead,’ said S. Jaishankar

item.title: The Hindu: Medicos warn against craze for fairness after 17-year-old Keralam girl diagnosed with kidney disorder
item.description: Medical experts say that the use of fairness creams containing heavy metals such as mercury to lighten the skin is emerging as a major health hazard that can lead to serious conditions such as kidney failure if not diagnosed early

item.title: The Hindu: Government has asked us to reconsider restricting all protests to Freedom Park, says Bengaluru’s new Chief Commissioner of Police
item.description: After having taken charge during a transition phase, R. Hithendra says his first order of business is to establish a new layer of top-level governance and resolve coordination issues between commissionerates

item.title: The Hindu: Madurai’s great gold heist
item.description: The daring heist at a newly opened jewellery showroom in Madurai, executed by a lone, first-time burglar who wanted to live a lavish life and become rich soon, has all the makings of a potboiler. This report narrates the story as it happened and how the police solved the crime

item.title: The Hindu: TDP defends venue choice for Vijayawada Mayor swearing-in, slams YSRCP for making it an issue
item.description: Vijayawada MP says there is no rule stating that the event has to be held at the VMC council hall; YSRCP corporators submit a representation to NTR District Collector seeking his intervention

item.title: The Hindu: Tenure focused on institutional reform-oriented approach, says outgoing UPPSC Chairman Sanjay Shrinet
item.description: ‘Under my leadership, the Commission adopted an extremely strict and transparent approach towards ensuring the integrity and security of examinations and enhancing the quality of confidential operations,’ said Sanjay Shrinet

item.title: The Hindu: West Bengal government to appoint coordinators for all 209 wards in Kolkata: Union Minister Sukanta Majumdar
item.description: This announcement comes as the Kolkata Corporation election remains stalled by the Calcutta High Court; Mamata-Trinamool says why not hold elections and appoint elected representatives

item.title: The Hindu: Police complaint against WB LoP, police officers for fabrication of affidavits before ECI
item.description: The police complaint, was registered at city’s Kalighat Police station by Subhasish Chakraborty on behalf of Trinamool Congress; in the complaint, the loyalist of Mamata Banerjee has claimed that he has credible proofs that Nanoor police station officials conspired with Ritabrata Banerjee and Arup Roy to prepare false and fabricated affidavits

item.title: The Hindu: Deepathoon row: State govt. consulting experts on filing review petition, says Minister
item.description: A decision will be taken soon on moving the petition against the Supreme Court’s interim order, says C.T.R. Nirmal Kumar; VCK chief says his party is firmly opposed to implementing the verdict

item.title: The Hindu: Are public toilet users in Chennai pulling the flush on irritants?
item.description: Two concessionaires engaged by Greater Chennai Corporation to manage public toilets unpack the feedback mechanism that has been put in place to drive cleanliness standards. They also present data about how Chennai residents provide that feedback
